author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Nintendo Switch™ 2 owners will soon have even more legendary worlds to explore on the go. Announced during the Nintendo Direct, several new award-winning Bethesda titles are joining The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition on the Nintendo Switch 2. 

From MachineGames’ critically acclaimed, globe‑trotting adventure Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™ — launching May 12, 2026, to Bethesda Game Studios’ hits Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition — launching February 24, 2026, and The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered — launching in 2026, players will have no shortage of epic adventures to dive into.
title: Bethesda x Nintendo Switch™ 2 — Reveal Trailer - Oblivion, Fallout 4, and Indiana Jones!
